view: PA (frontal) chest radiograph, erect; L side marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate. No significant rotation (spinous processes midline between clavicular heads). Inspiration slightly shallow (approx. 8-9 posterior ribs visible). Penetration adequate with thoracic spine faintly visible through the heart. Both costophrenic angles and lung apices included. Scapulae partially project over the upper lateral lung fields. A black vertical bar at the far left image edge is a digital/collimation artifact.

devices.location: Image upper right, over the patient's left shoulder/axillary soft tissue, outside the lung field
Image upper right, patient's left shoulder region
Far left image edge, outside the patient

abnormalities.finding: Prominent, dense left hilum with a somewhat lobulated contour, larger than the right hilum; likely prominent left pulmonary artery but a hilar mass or lymphadenopathy cannot be excluded on this single view
Prominent and tortuous aortic knob / unfolded thoracic aorta, consistent with age-related aortic ectasia and atherosclerosis
Mildly increased bronchovascular / reticular markings in the right perihilar and mid zone; no frank consolidation, air bronchogram or nodule identified
Bilateral large breast shadows overlying the lower zones, producing mild symmetric increased density at both lung bases (soft-tissue overlap, not a parenchymal lesion)

description_zh: 正面站立胸部X光，攝影品質尚可，無明顯旋轉，吸氣稍淺；片右上方可見L側標記與一圓形金屬外部標記，片左緣黑色遮蔽帶為影像偽影，未見任何胸管、導管或心律調節器。心臟大小正常，氣管居中，主動脈弓突出且迂曲；左側肺門較右側飽滿緻密、輪廓略呈分葉狀，以肺動脈突出為可能，但無法完全排除肺門腫塊或淋巴結腫大，建議與臨床及CT對照。右側中肺野支氣管血管紋理輕度增加，未見明確肺實質化、結節、氣胸或肋膜積液，兩側肋膈角銳利，橫膈輪廓清楚，左側橫膈下可見胃泡。雙側乳房陰影重疊於下肺野，骨骼結構未見明顯骨折或破壞性病灶。
